page_title: NOT 0-1 LIV | Nottingham Forest v Liverpool 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+10' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Liverpool players have a reason to celebrate!
90+8' Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor has indicated he is going to review the Liverpool goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90+7' 0 - 1 Goal! Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
90+4' Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
90+3' That's the end of the game for Morgan Gibbs-White, who is replaced by James McAtee (Nottingham).
90+2' Celebrations are cut short for Liverpool as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
90+1' Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor has indicated he is going to review the Liverpool goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' GOAL! And here’s a contender for the end of season bloopers video as the defender misjudges his clearance, sending the ball into the net off the body of Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool).
88' Nottingham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

87' Ola Aina (Nottingham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Nottingham win a corner kick.
86' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
83' Arne Slot has decided to make a change. Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) replaces Milos Kerkez.
83' It will be a substitution. Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is ready to enter the pitch as Curtis Jones walks off.
82' Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
80' Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
79' Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham) brings an opponent down and Anthony Taylor interrupts the game.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) will replace Cody Gakpo.
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) for Mohamed Salah.
77' Vitor Pereira prepares a substitution. Elliot Anderson is replaced by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham).
77' Substitution. Igor Jesus makes his way off the pitch and Lorenzo Lucca (Nottingham) comes on as his replacement.
76' Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham) is adjudged offside.
75' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
72' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
71' Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
70' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
69' Foul! Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
66' Vitor Pereira has decided to substitute Omari Hutchinson and he is replaced by Dilane Bakwa (Nottingham).
66' Substitution. Callum Hudson-Odoi leaves the pitch and is replaced by Dan Ndoye (Nottingham).
65' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
61' A yellow card for a tackle by Ola Aina (Nottingham). Anthony Taylor doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
59' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is flagged for offside.
58' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
56' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
54' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Stefan Ortega makes a great save.
53' Anthony Taylor blows for a foul after Ola Aina (Nottingham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
53' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Curtis Jones (Liverpool) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
52' The Liverpool players are exchanging some short passes.
49' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes the ball! His attempt flies narrowly wide of the left post.
49' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
48' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Nottingham will have a chance to score from a corner.
48' The resulting corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is cleared.

48' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
47' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

46' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, Liverpool are going to take it.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
45+2' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A promising move ends with a clever pass to Elliot Anderson (Nottingham), who hits a first-time shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
43' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

43' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball is out of play and Nottingham manage to earn a corner.
42' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
41' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
41' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alisson intercepts the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Nottingham.
39' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
38' Rough tackle by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
36' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempts to find Cody Gakpo, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
35' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and it's Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
35' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
34' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
31' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
30' Ola Aina (Nottingham) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
28' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
26' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
25' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
24' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
23' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

22' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick low shot towards the middle of the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows Alisson to make a comfortable save.
21' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
20' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
20' Murillo (Nottingham) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
18' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

17' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Another situation results in a direct free kick for Nottingham.
17' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
16' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is penalised for a foul. Anthony Taylor had a clear view and blows his whistle.
14' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) is furious with himself. He is quickest to the rebound near the penalty spot, but his header goes well over the crossbar!
14' The free kick is taken by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), but ball is cleared.
13' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham). Anthony Taylor saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Liverpool have a free kick from a promising distance.
11' Referee Anthony Taylor sees the trip by Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.

11' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
10' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
9' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul after Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) hacks down one of his opponents. Nottingham are awarded a free kick.
8' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
7' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

6' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Nottingham will have a corner.
6' The ball is cleared after Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
3' Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
2' Liverpool seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Liverpool will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Anthony Taylor.
